trap: The room is full of water and has no way on except down: swimming does not get out of it, the floor must be dug
cue: The floor under the water is thin ground, and the cellar below it is an empty hall with a doorway at its far end
notes: Dig the floor and the water runs into the cellar and out through the doorway; the player either drains the room first (stands on the floor, digs, waits) or falls through with it. Natural connectivity counts the floor as passable (dig_zone).

lessons.note: The flooded room has no other exit; the way out is to dig through the floor under the water: the water drains into the cellar below and you follow it down

flooded_room_exit.about: how to get out of the room that is full of water
